name: creavia
description: Creavia: create, publish and grow, on your computer or your own cloud.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w cloud && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.test: npm test -w desktop && npm test -w cloud && cd desktop/src-tauri && cargo test --lib
scripts.lint: biome ci . && (cd engine && ruff check . && ruff format --check .) && cd desktop/src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --lib --bins --tests -- -D warnings
scripts.format: biome check --write . && (cd engine && ruff format .) && cd desktop/src-tauri && cargo fmt
